name: Castellanos de Zapardiel (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically crimson and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castellanos de Zapardiel (a dove on blue above a tower on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Castellanos de Zapardiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castellanos de Zapardiel arms — dove and tower
